Local Tastes
Raclette du Valais AOP
A protected semi-hard cheese native to this canton, scraped molten from the wheel over potatoes, pickles and cured meat — a tradition mountain pasture workers began in the 16th century, named for the French verb racler, to scrape.
Restaurant Schäferstube · Whymper Stube
Zermatt Lamb
Valais mountain lamb, grilled over an open wood fire — a specialty of the pastoral Upper Valais, served at the same chalet-style houses that serve raclette and fondue.
Restaurant Schäferstube
Food Delivery
No dependable app-wide delivery network serves every Zermatt address; ask the hotel to order directly from a participating restaurant.
Getting Around
No conventional ride-hailing service operates across the car-free village; walk or use the local electric taxi and mountain railway network.

Heads Up
Zermatt Railway Station — Car-Free Village
Zermatt has no public road access for visitors' cars; drivers park in Täsch and ride the 12-minute shuttle train in.
Matterhorn Glacier Paradise — No Passport Needed
Despite local rumor, the lift crossing into Italy at Testa Grigia requires no passport for a same-day visit.
Gornergrat & Klein Matterhorn — Wind Can Close the Lifts
High-altitude cable cars can pause in strong wind even when the village below feels calm — build in a buffer if a summit view matters.
Zermatt — Emergency Numbers
General 112 · Ambulance 144 · Police 117 · Mountain rescue — REGA 1414.

Packing for a Hike
Worth Knowing

The mountains set the timetable

Cloud often builds after midday, so put the clearest panorama first and keep a village walk as the flexible fallback. Mountain lifts can pause in high wind even when conditions in Zermatt feel calm.

Zermatt is car-free, but it is not traffic-free: compact electric taxis and delivery vehicles share the narrow lanes. Listen for the quiet motors when stepping out from a shop or crossing Bahnhofstrasse.

At 3,883 metres, Matterhorn Glacier Paradise is high enough for altitude symptoms. Move slowly, hydrate, and descend promptly if headache, nausea or dizziness develops.
